evidence: RSD=CRE says the two mechanisms assign equal frequency to each efficient matching once those frequencies are known; it does not determine which frequency partitions occur over all profiles.

The ten-type reduction plus the definition of RP makes the remaining computation finite but does not algebraically force a unique matching-support spectrum from the published marginal assignment matrix alone, because a bistochastic matrix can admit multiple matching decompositions.

value.rationale: The deterministic-matching support of RSD is a natural canonical decomposition, and the theorem gives its complete smallest-market geometry, including the non-obvious support-five exclusion and exact prevalence of every shape. Although the domain is finite and the classical ten-profile reduction is prior, this is a coherent complete classification of a standard mechanism rather than an arbitrary slice.

final_claim: For strict three-agent, three-object random serial dictatorship, the six priority orders induce exactly five deterministic-matching multiplicity spectra, with labeled-profile counts 48, 36, 72, 54, and 6 respectively; support size five is impossible, and CRE has the same matching multiplicities by the classical frequency theorem.
limitations: Strict 3-by-3 house allocation and uniform random priority only; no larger-market or weak-preference classification.
